channel.title: Official Gazette of the Irad Special Economic Zone
channel.description: Monthly issues of the Official Gazette of the ISEZ: executive directives and decrees of the Governor, notices of the Bank of Irad and official notices.

item.title: Official Gazette of the ISEZ, No. 10 (October 2026)
item.description: In this issue: Notice of 1 October 2026: e-Irad public services portal opens in pilot; Notice of 8 October 2026: Addition to the list of restricted sites (unlicensed financial activity); Draft order (for comment) of 16 October 2026: On the temporary suspension of imports of table potatoes.

item.title: Official Gazette of the ISEZ, No. 9 (September 2026)
item.description: In this issue: Notice of 15 September 2026: General election of 2 November 2027: preliminary calendar; Bank of Irad statement of 24 September 2026: On the digital token marketed as “Tulparcoin”; Executive Directive 2026/31 of 26 September 2026: On the printing of textbooks for public schools, 2027–2030; Bank of Irad Notice 2026/5 of 29 September 2026: On payment services offered without a licence.

item.title: Official Gazette of the ISEZ, No. 8 (August 2026)
item.description: In this issue: Executive Directive 2026/24 of 12 August 2026: On the census of business entities, 2026.

item.title: Official Gazette of the ISEZ, No. 5 (May 2026)
item.description: In this issue: Bank of Irad Notice 2026/2 of 4 May 2026: On cash operations in United States dollars.
